_: Voice narration on GitHub with Gemini TTS (.github/workflows/narration-tts.yml). Edit, commit, push: the workflow voices what is listed and commits the takes to audio/vo-takes/. `audition`: voices for audio/vo-audition.py; `takes`: named takes (voice, text, style) to try a direction or a pronunciation; `scripts`: synth-vo.py scripts to voice in `voice`. Bump `run` to re-run with no other change. `name_variants`: voice each script once per way of saying the name (say_name, name_note).

takes.name: name-A-Mack-eena
takes.text: That's exactly why we made Mack-eena. Mack-eena. Everything you save, finally useful.
takes.style: Playful and warm, like telling a good friend something you're a little excited about: a smile in the voice, bright and proud on the name. Pace: lively and quick, like real chatty conversation between friends, about 170 words a minute; keep pauses short and light, no long dramatic beats.

takes.name: name-B-Mackeena-note
takes.text: That's exactly why we made Mackeena. Mackeena. Everything you save, finally useful.
takes.style: Playful and warm, like telling a good friend something you're a little excited about: a smile in the voice, bright and proud on the name. Pace: lively and quick, like real chatty conversation between friends, about 170 words a minute; keep pauses short and light, no long dramatic beats. The product name is pronounced MACK-ee-nuh (IPA /ˈmækiːnə/, exactly as the house narrator says it): stress on the FIRST syllable, "mack" as in "mackerel", then a long "ee", then a soft "nuh". Never "mah-KEE-nah", never "MAH-chee-nah", never "ma-SHEE-nah".
